records.sourceText: Material in this plan that has not been extracted into those authorities remains a proposal, not a parallel semantic authority
records.semanticRule: Unextracted migration-plan material stays a proposal; only the applicable PDP authority and its explicitly accepted decisions define canonical product meaning. Execution-plan text cannot create a parallel semantic authority.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: An unextracted plan clause is explicitly marked proposal and resolves to no canonical product state until an applicable PDP decision accepts it.
records.negativeOracle: Promoting unextracted plan prose to an accepted operation/state meaning.

records.sourceText: Task order, migration procedure, phase deliverables, verification strategy, and downstream handoff guidance remain useful execution references.
records.semanticRule: Task order, migration procedure, phase deliverables, verification strategy and downstream handoff guidance remain execution references. They do not establish source correctness, task completion, phase acceptance or current Lifecycle receipt.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A report may use the plan for sequencing while independently sourcing task and phase status.
records.negativeOracle: Treating an execution checklist entry as evidence that its product obligation or acceptance gate is complete.

records.sourceText: change only with a separately approved compatibility map |
records.semanticRule: Existing Java namespaces remain compatible during relocation; namespace changes require a separately approved compatibility map.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A namespace change is blocked until an explicit compatibility map is approved.
records.negativeOracle: Inferring approval from package relocation or source availability.

records.sourceText: Request owner improvements rather than copying implementations |
records.semanticRule: Media consumes accepted published Shared contracts and requests owner improvements rather than copying Shared implementations. Unpublished or unaccepted contracts do not imply package readiness.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A Media adapter references a versioned public Shared contract and records missing capability as a dependency.
records.negativeOracle: Vendoring or duplicating generic Shared implementation as a substitute for an accepted public contract.

records.sourceText: Clinical/organizational intake and review meaning
records.semanticRule: Clinical and organizational intake/review meaning remains owned by the domain product; Media preserves the document-extraction integration and never makes clinical or KYC decisions.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: Media returns extracted media/document evidence without asserting clinical or identity conclusions.
records.negativeOracle: Inferring or changing clinical, organizational, or KYC decisions from media extraction.

records.sourceText: it is not another editable set of rules.
records.semanticRule: The readable product constitution is generated from or unambiguously references the single structured requirement register; it is not a second editable rule set.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: Changing canonical requirement meaning changes the structured register and the generated/readable representation follows it.
records.negativeOracle: Editing the readable constitution independently as a competing policy authority.

records.sourceText: Declared, qualified and currently available are different states
records.semanticRule: Declared, qualified and currently available are distinct states. A declaration does not prove qualification; qualification does not prove present availability.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A result reports each dimension separately with evidence or UNKNOWN.
records.negativeOracle: Collapsing declaration, qualification and availability into a single eligible/supported label.

records.sourceText: Preserve the source and compare the result.
records.semanticRule: Quality review preserves the exact source and compares the candidate/result against that source; preservation evidence and measured deltas are explicit.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A review record binds immutable source and result versions plus metric/evidence references.
records.negativeOracle: Replacing the source or treating a sharper-looking result as sufficient acceptance.

records.sourceText: not a mutation of the source graph |
records.semanticRule: MediaRun and Checkpoint represent mutable execution progression and immutable observations; they do not mutate the source graph.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A run appends execution observations while source graph identity/version remains unchanged.
records.negativeOracle: Writing run/checkpoint status as a source-graph edit.

records.sourceText: Use deterministic measurements when sufficient.
records.semanticRule: Use deterministic measurements when they are sufficient for the requested analysis or decision.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A deterministic measurement is selected when its declared applicability covers the requested subject and metric.
records.negativeOracle: Dispatching a generative model when deterministic measurements already satisfy the stated need.

records.sourceText: generative models may repair only within authorized preservation/cost bounds.
records.semanticRule: Generative repair is permitted only within explicit authorized preservation and cost bounds; an LLM critique alone cannot approve technical or scientific correctness.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: Repair inputs bind preservation constraints and cost limits, and review uses independent measurement evidence.
records.negativeOracle: Allowing a generative change outside authorized bounds or approving it from critique text alone.

records.sourceText: `preserve`, `enhance`, `creative`
records.semanticRule: The values `preserve`, `enhance`, and `creative` are distinct requested processing intents and retain their separate policy implications.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A request records one declared intent and selects only transformations allowed for that intent.
records.negativeOracle: Treating creative intent as permission to violate preservation constraints, or treating preserve as a generative repair request.

records.sourceText: Record requested/effective profiles and reasons.
records.semanticRule: Fallback records requested and effective profiles and the reason for each difference, including the relevant quality, resource and confirmation bounds.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A fallback observation names both profiles and an explicit reason/changed dimension.
records.negativeOracle: Silently substituting a profile or treating resource failure as permission to change a strict output.

records.sourceText: Preserve existing response shapes for supported consumers until explicit version negotiation/migration.
records.semanticRule: Supported consumers retain their existing response shapes until explicit version negotiation or migration authorizes a shape change.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A response-shape change is gated by a versioned compatibility map and consumer negotiation.
records.negativeOracle: Changing a supported response shape merely because a new implementation or schema exists.

records.sourceText: Define fail-fast versus continue-on-item-failure explicitly
records.semanticRule: A batch contract explicitly selects fail-fast or continue-on-item-failure semantics and reports per-item results accordingly.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: The batch definition names its failure mode and returns each attempted item outcome under continue mode.
records.negativeOracle: Inferring batch failure behavior from worker ordering or hiding failed items behind one aggregate success.

records.sourceText: Submit, status/list, progress stream or polling, cancel, explicit retry, reconcile, output lookup
records.semanticRule: Long-running work defines submit, status/list, progress observation, cancel request, explicit retry, reconciliation and output lookup as separate operations with separate finality.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A client can distinguish submission receipt, status observation, cancellation request, retry request, reconciliation and registered output.
records.negativeOracle: Treating stop-watching as cancellation, retry as reconciliation, or accepted submission as completed output.

records.sourceText: | Project/scene/timeline
records.semanticRule: The project/scene/timeline context remains the explicit ownership boundary for the described composition workflow.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A scene or timeline edit is scoped to its exact project and source version.
records.negativeOracle: Applying a scene/timeline operation to a global or unrelated project context.

records.sourceText: Published-package tests run without sibling repository source, provider credentials or runtime implementation imports.
records.semanticRule: Published-package tests execute without sibling repository source, provider credentials or runtime-implementation imports.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: An isolated consumer installs the packed artifact and validates exports and representative contracts with no monorepo path dependency.
records.negativeOracle: Passing only because source files, provider credentials or implementation modules are reachable from the checkout.

records.sourceText: Simple aliases compile into the same request/plan
records.semanticRule: Simple CLI aliases compile to the same canonical request/plan as their long form.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: Alias and canonical form produce structurally identical request plans for equivalent arguments.
records.negativeOracle: Giving an alias distinct business semantics or silently changing the selected operation.

records.sourceText: `plan --request FILE`, `run --plan FILE`, `run --request FILE`
records.semanticRule: The CLI distinguishes planning from execution: `plan --request FILE`, `run --plan FILE`, and `run --request FILE` have explicit, non-interchangeable input semantics.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: Each accepted form resolves to the documented plan or request type before any execution request.
records.negativeOracle: Treating plan creation as execution authorization or accepting an unrelated file shape.

records.sourceText: Diagnostics use stderr and are redacted.
records.semanticRule: Diagnostics are written to stderr and redacted before emission.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A diagnostic uses stderr and removes configured sensitive values while preserving actionable non-sensitive context.
records.negativeOracle: Writing diagnostic content to stdout or exposing credentials, private media, or sensitive identifiers.

records.sourceText: Enforce at upload/import admission
records.semanticRule: Rights, consent, retention and format admission are enforced at upload/import boundaries before bytes become admitted Media artifacts.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: Upload/import admission denies missing, stale, mismatched or revoked policy evidence.
records.negativeOracle: Treating upload completion or byte receipt as proof of rights or artifact availability.

records.sourceText: Check revocation/expiry at appropriate boundaries during long-running/streaming work.
records.semanticRule: Long-running and streaming work rechecks revocation and expiry at the relevant effect boundaries; a prior check does not authorize later work indefinitely.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: Each later governed effect uses current rights/consent/retention evidence for the exact subject and purpose.
records.negativeOracle: Continuing based solely on an earlier admission after expiry, revocation, or policy-version change.

records.sourceText: A downloaded or published copy may be beyond Media’s control
records.semanticRule: A downloaded or published copy can be beyond Media control; Media reports its own copy and any external deletion only when deployment-specific evidence confirms it.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: The product distinguishes Media erasure from external-copy status and reports external status as UNKNOWN without proof.
records.negativeOracle: Claiming external copies were erased because Media deleted its own record or key.

records.sourceText: delivery to a central sink may be asynchronous through an admitted durable path.
records.semanticRule: Delivery to a central sink may be asynchronous only through an admitted durable path, with request acceptance separate from sink acknowledgement.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: The operation records a durable delivery intent and later reports a separately observed sink acknowledgement.
records.negativeOracle: Treating queue acceptance or transient transport success as central-sink delivery.

records.sourceText: They do not rewrite old execution evidence.
records.semanticRule: New mappings and policy changes do not rewrite historical execution evidence; historical records retain the meaning/version under which they were produced.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A new policy version applies prospectively while prior evidence remains bound to its original version.
records.negativeOracle: Reinterpreting old execution results as if the current policy had governed them.

records.sourceText: Reuse is tenant/ownership compatible and rechecks current rights, consent, retention, license and policy even if bytes are identical.
records.semanticRule: Reuse requires tenant/ownership compatibility and fresh checks of rights, consent, retention, license and policy even when media bytes are identical.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A reuse decision binds the exact tenant, owner, subject version and all current policy dimensions.
records.negativeOracle: Using byte equality as a substitute for authorization or cross-tenant isolation.

records.sourceText: Never share private embeddings, voice models, prompts, sensitive deduplication existence or generated candidates across tenants by default.
records.semanticRule: Private embeddings, voice models, prompts, sensitive deduplication existence and generated candidates are not shared across tenants by default.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: Cross-tenant reuse requires an explicit independently authorized policy and scoped evidence; otherwise sharing is denied.
records.negativeOracle: Leaking sensitive existence or derived data through shared caches, logs, candidate lists or embeddings.

records.sourceText: Profiles, provider diagnostics, rights detail, provenance and operations are contextual or role-scoped.
records.semanticRule: Profiles, provider diagnostics, rights detail, provenance and operational details are shown only in the relevant context and to an authorized role.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A view reveals only fields needed for its purpose and permitted by the current role/scope.
records.negativeOracle: Showing sensitive operational or rights detail solely because the user can open the product.

records.sourceText: Every surface answers context, goal, current state, next action and material blocker.
records.semanticRule: Every product surface explains context, goal, current state, next action and material blocker using source-backed state; unsupported state remains UNKNOWN.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A screen binds each displayed status and next action to its exact query/observation and current version.
records.negativeOracle: Showing generic status copy that implies progress, readiness or success without matching evidence.

records.sourceText: Automatically apply only transformations admitted by the project’s preservation, quality and budget policy.
records.semanticRule: Transformations apply automatically only when the project preservation, quality and budget policy admits the exact transformation.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: The auto-apply decision binds the exact project/version, transformation, policy and measured limits.
records.negativeOracle: Applying a suggestion merely because a model produced it or because defaults exist.

records.sourceText: Contextual suggestions appear near relevant work: “Speech detected—add captions,” “These clips have inconsistent color,” or “This scene needs review.” Conversational intent is optional, never the only route.
records.semanticRule: Contextual suggestions appear near relevant work; conversational intent is optional and never the only route to the action.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: The same action remains discoverable through visible contextual controls without a chat interaction.
records.negativeOracle: Making a conversational assistant the sole way to invoke an ordinary product action.

records.sourceText: A user may stop watching without cancelling.
records.semanticRule: Stopping observation or progress watching does not cancel or mutate the underlying operation.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A stop-watching control ends the local observation stream while the job remains independently observable.
records.negativeOracle: Sending a cancellation request when a user only stops watching.

records.sourceText: visible audio controls
records.semanticRule: Audio mixing exposes visible controls and keyboard-operable alternatives for the same adjustment.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: A user can identify and adjust audio parameters without relying on pointer-only controls.
records.negativeOracle: Requiring drag-only interaction or hiding the active audio value from assistive technology.

records.sourceText: Avoid assuming machine captions, descriptions or translations are correct.
records.semanticRule: Machine-produced captions, descriptions and translations remain reviewable candidates; their correctness is never presumed.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: The UI distinguishes generated content from human-reviewed or approved content and binds review to an exact version.
records.negativeOracle: Presenting generated language content as verified or approved without evidence.

records.sourceText: Validate the exact public exports, compatible versions, transitive closure and representative consumer tests.
records.semanticRule: Validation covers exact public exports, compatible versions, transitive dependency closure and representative installed-consumer behavior.
records.gap: Root material review required; no migration ledger or acceptance status changed.
records.positiveOracle: The packed artifact is tested from an isolated consumer against the declared export surface and resolved dependency set.
records.negativeOracle: Treating source-tree tests or a successful build as proof of package compatibility.

records.sourceText: Obtain appropriate legal review before distribution where obligations or patents are uncertain.

records.positiveOracle: Uncertain obligations or patents block distribution until documented legal review resolves the issue.

records.sourceText: Reuse mechanics only through accepted public/extracted interfaces.
